concept: Every action in reach of the keyboard: a level-3 pane over the scrim with a field and grouped commands.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a command palette as a full-screen dark overlay with a huge search field
default_to_avoid.kind: command palette, command menu, quick open
default_to_avoid.why_not: a full-screen overlay hides where the reader was; Pane opens a pane near the top over a scrim

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the palette is a level-3 pane over the scrim like Dialog, near the top of the screen

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: focus stays in the field while arrow keys move the highlight, Enter runs and Esc closes

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the highlighted row takes the menu lens so it reads by shape as well as tone

options: A level-3 pane near the top
C dropdown from a search bar
variants.picked: A level-3 pane near the top
variants.reason: A keeps the page in view behind the scrim (P3). B hides it. C cannot be opened from anywhere.

root.why: the palette is a level-3 pane centred near the top and capped in height

hidden.why: the dialog has a hidden title so it is announced as the command palette

field.why: the field row holds the magnifier over the groove, inset from the pane edge

glyph.why: the magnifier is in the secondary tone so the typed query leads

input.why: the query sits in the Input groove at the emphasis size so it reads as a field

list.why: the commands scroll inside the pane with a small inset

group.why: groups are separated by a small gap so each heading starts a block

heading.why: group headings are secondary at caption size so the commands are read first

row.why: each command is a 44px row with its icon, label and keys

on.why: the highlighted command takes the quiet surface and the menu lens

icon.why: command icons are in the secondary tone so each label is read first

label.why: the command label is at body size and wraps

keys.why: shortcut keys are shown as Kbd at the row end

empty.why: when nothing matches the palette says so in words

foot.why: the foot lists the keys in the secondary tone at caption size

preview.why: in a preview the palette sits in place in its parent without the scrim, for docs only

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

focus-visible.why: the field shows the focus ring when the palette opens from the keyboard

@drop.why: the palette drops in a short distance and settles on the hover ease
